surfaces.mechanism_doc: SCIM 2.0 per Hub auth module, tenant URL `<hub-base-url>/api/rest/scim2`; GET /api/rest/scim2/Users (RFC 7644 3.4.2 ListResponse); per-module SCIM tokens; excludes scheduled sync; Okta OIDC apps unsupported
surfaces.notes: IDE Services Cloud / License Vault Cloud identity, not Central. Built (lane ENTAPI-L16E, T-717) for Identity: a customer_host surface (Hub runs on the customer's domain; the connection declares the tuple, ledger VCONN-HOST-1; a Hub under a path prefix such as /hub is not reachable because the tuple carries no path). Driver internal/vendorapi/jetbrains HubSCIM: GET /api/rest/scim2/Users, startIndex (1-based) and count 100, no filter; the SCIM ListResponse pages by the offset family with a 1-based index (an echoed startIndex other than the one asked, a short total or a repeated last user is drift). Landed as User/jetbrains.hub_user/v1 keyed jetbrains.hub_user = SCIM id: primary e-mail (folded), active, created and last modified times; the display name (else formatted name, else userName) is the display name; groups, roles, entitlements and extensions are never decoded (closed DTO). A complete page set is authoritative for the module's users. Hub documents only the endpoint and the token, so that Hub answers the RFC 7643 ListResponse is Inferred: assumption_tested. The token is the IdP's provisioning credential and can write users; Observer only reads (ledger VCONN-HOST-5). Groups stays buildable. Synthetic only, no vendor response observed.

surfaces.notes: Built (lane ENTAPI-L16C, T-710): the first customer_host surface. IDE Services runs on the customer's own domain, so the row declares no host: each connection declares its own https tuple (validated like a catalog tuple, never an IP literal or a single label; audited on the connection routes; ledger VCONN-HOST-1), and a private address is dialed only for a tuple the server operator lists in [vendor_connections].customer_host_private_tuples. Driver internal/vendorapi/jetbrains Users (GET /api/v1/users, automation token as Authorization: Automation <token>), conformance against the vendormock mock (prefixed scheme), landed as User/jetbrains.ideservices_user/v1 resources keyed jetbrains.ideservices_user = user id: email, role, is_active, created_at; the username is the display name; createdBy is not landed; a complete list is authoritative. The Roles supply (the role is landed as an attribute) stays buildable. The reference shows no list response: that it is an array of the documented user object is Inferred, so assumption_tested only. Synthetic only, no vendor response observed. Secret class reviewed: user metadata only.
